The implementation is complete and fully verified. Summary of what was built:

## `submission/main.py` (566 lines,18 KiB, stdlib-only)

**Framing & validation** — one JSON request per stdin line → one JSON response per line. Strict schema checks: duplicate-key detection (`object_pairs_hook`), rejection of non-finite constants, exact key sets per object, integer types (excluding booleans/floats), ID pattern `[A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,32}`, lowercase even-length hex, all documented ranges (path 2..9, H 8..256, labels 16..1048575, capacities 0..512, events 0..20000, counts, run lists). Anything malformed yields exactly `{"error":"input"}`; a bad line never disturbs later lines.

**Replay mode** — per-node label tables with the exact `put` priority (idempotent `ok` → `busy` when an enabled flow owns the pair → `full` when the node is at capacity and the label is absent → install), `enable` requiring every path node to hold the flow's entry (`unready` otherwise), `disable` establishing the drain barrier so labels become reusable, and `reset` clearing compressors while retaining tables. Packets classify `disabled → mismatch → qos → compressed`, then forward over N links with the compressor not decrementing TTL, switches dropping on TTL ≤ 1, MPLS links encoded as `uint32_be((label<<12)|(Q<<9)|(1<<8)|ttl) || residue || payload`, and IP fallback emitting the original header with only T updated. `delivered` restores K from template, D from residue, Z as zero, Q from TC, T from the final TTL; `byte_hops` accounts every emitted link.

**Plan mode** — per-flow benefit `(H-4-#D)*N` × eligible packets (post-warmup, K-matching, Q≤7, TTL>h). Exact optimum under every node's entry capacity via branch-and-bound with a fractional-knapsack bound over the aggregated capacity relaxation, SWAR-packed per-node counters for O(1) feasibility, and a count lower bound to enforce the "minimum flows among maximum-benefit sets" secondary objective; `{"infeasible":true}` when pinned flows alone exceed capacity.

**Validation performed**: public fixtures pass; 800 randomized replays matched an independent hop-by-hop reference model; 600+ randomized plans matched exhaustive brute force (value *and* selection count); 22-flow adversarial instances survived an independent local-search optimality attack;75 hand-written invalid requests all rejected; worst-case runtimes ≤ 0.1 s (budget 30 s).
